analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($76,030) vs SMA5 ($78,530)/SMA20 ($84,581)/SMA50 ($95,488): indicating short-to-mid term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($102,445)/SMA200 ($101,111): confirming long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (22.4%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.0 → 33.8): entering oversold territory, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (83.5308 → -91.5413): continued worsening, confirming bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $73,277): approaching lower band, with band width at 26.73% indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support level ($76,010): based on 5/20-day lows, near current price.
· Swing resistance level ($86,590): potential for short-term bounce if breached.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways, no trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.57x): increasing confidence in price movement, but direction confirmation needed.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
